reply.text:
That one is outside what I can help with. Dosing steroids, whether a full cycle or a microdose, is a medical question, and there's no version of it I can call safe from a coach's chair. A doctor, ideally one who does bloodwork and knows your history, is the person to talk to about it.

On the training side, I'm glad to help you get more out of your lifting through programming, progression, eating enough protein, and sleep. Want me to look at where your lifts are sitting and build from there?
